set.body: Found during the 2026-09-17 eyes4s.md sync. PRD S-2 says v1.0 ships gaussian and anisotropic smoothers; the closed ticket s-smoother claims both, but surface/Smoother.scala has only Smoother.gaussian(sigma, edgePolicy) (Pyramid reuses it) and no anisotropic or foveal kernel exists anywhere. Either implement the anisotropic smoother with a SmootherCard and bandwidth rule, or amend PRD S-2 and eyes4s.md to defer it. The spec status line cites this ticket.
set.title: Anisotropic smoother promised by PRD S-2 is not implemented
